title: Obsidian Plugin Manifest (manifest.json)
description: Selected documented manifest constraints; naming uniqueness and directory review require separate verification.

id.description: Lowercase letters and hyphens; cannot contain obsidian or end with plugin.

name.description: Human-readable display name without redundant 'Obsidian' or 'Plugin' words.

version.description: Exact X.Y.Z semantic version without leading 'v' or prerelease suffix for Community Store releases.

minAppVersion.description: Minimum Obsidian desktop/mobile version required to load the plugin.

description.description: Description of the plugin. Local editorial length recommendations are not schema limits.
